edit.with: docs/code/bank0C-scene-spawn-tables-comet.md lists the thinker for 'World Map, Inventory'; the records are for scene $FD (Statue Inventory) and scene $FF (Inventory), and scene $FE (World Map) does not start it (measured: no start of bundle #03 in $FE with flag #01 set). Bundle #03 is one strip of 8 frames of two colours at CGRAM $CE-$CF with 3 extra ticks per frame, 32 ticks per pass (measured): a grey pulse, $CE $5EF7 to $4210 and $CF $7FFF to $5EF7 and back. In these two scenes the only code that sets flag #01 is the item-use script of the inventory (item_use_system sets it at {231958} in UseItem_WindFlute_Effect, and at {232552}, {234433}, {235734} and {235760}); with the flag set the child restarts the bundle on every pass (measured: 9 starts of #03 in 240 ticks in each of $FD and $FF with the flag set at tick 5).
